Case No. 1:26-cv-02331

MEMORANDUM IN SUPPORT OF PLAINTIFF’S MOTION FOR LEAVE TO FILE NOTICE OF SUBSEQUENT RECORD DEVELOPMENT RELEVANT TO ECF NOS. 93 AND 97–99

Plaintiff seeks leave to place one subsequent record development before the District Judge in connection with ECF Nos. 93 and 97–99. Local Civil Rule 7(F)(1) provides that “[n]o further briefs or written communications may be filed without first obtaining leave of Court.” Plaintiff seeks that leave.

ECF No. 93 requests withdrawal or modification of the magistrate-judge referral, interim protection, and coordinated determination. ECF No. 93 ¶ 10(R1), (R5), (R6). ECF No. 97 requests identification of the authority and procedure that produced the successor designation, and coordinated determination. ECF No. 97 ¶¶ 15, 20(6)–(7). Plaintiff’s consolidated reply in support of ECF Nos. 90 and 93 was filed October 28, 2026. ECF No. 102.

ECF No. 108 was signed and filed October 29, 2026 and entered on the docket October 30, 2026. It postdates ECF No. 102 and ECF Nos. 97–99. It was entered under the successor designation recorded October 22, 2026. It states: “Here, the record reflects that the District Judge has chosen to refrain from beginning any discovery until resolution of the pending motions to dismiss.” ECF No. 108 at 2.

In this action, Plaintiff moved under Local Civil Rule 7(F)(1) for leave to file a supplemental memorandum addressing a filing made after ECF No. 15 was filed. ECF No. 78 at 1–2. The Court granted that motion and accepted it as a reply to ECF Nos. 33 and 74. ECF No. 82 at 1.

The proposed Notice is confined to ECF No. 108. It repeats no argument from ECF Nos. 94, 99, or 102, adds no ground, and requests no relief beyond that already requested in ECF Nos. 93 and 97–99. Leave should be granted.
